Kabhi desh ke audyogik vikas ki majbut ninv rakhne vala aur bhari mashinon ke nirman men duniya men apni alag pahchan banane vala hevi injiniyring korporeshan (HEC) aaj khud apne astitv ko bachane ki laraee lar raha hai. ranchi ke hatiya men 1958 men sthapit echaeesi ko desh ke audyogik vikas men mahatvapurn yogdan ke lie 'madar oph ol indastrij' kaha jata hai.
